overviewParagraphs: Located just a short 20-minute drive from the center of Chiang Mai, Mae Jo Golf Club is widely considered one of the most picturesque and enjoyable courses in Northern Thailand. Designed by local Thai architect Seni Thirawat, the layout fits seamlessly into its natural surroundings.

The course is beautifully routed through mature fruit orchards featuring mango, pomelo, and lychee trees, which provide both a visual feast and strategic obstacles. The defining characteristic of Mae Jo is the breathtaking views of the iconic Doi Suthep temple and the surrounding mountain ranges, which are visible from nearly every hole.

While relatively short at 6,730 yards from the back tees, Mae Jo is a thinking player's course. It demands precision off the tee and careful distance control on approaches to the firm, undulating Korean Velvet greens. It's an idyllic addition to any Chiang Mai golf itinerary.

curatorBriefHtml: Mae Jo Golf Resort & Spa is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Chiang Mai, Thailand, crafted by Seni Thirawat (2004) and stretching to 6,730 Yards across a parkland / orchard environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its fruit orchard & forest landscape (Surrounded by Longan trees) and fun undulating greens & doglegs (Strategic thinking test).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Mae Jo Golf Resort & Spa (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Thailand dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its friendly lanna caddie culture (Renowned northern hospitality), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Chiang Mai golf tour by AGS, Mae Jo Golf Resort & Spa provides a distinct architectural test by Seni Thirawat that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Mae Jo Golf Resort & Spa?
faqs.a: Mae Jo Golf Resort & Spa in Chiang Mai, Thailand is a Par 72 championship layout designed by Seni Thirawat (opened 2004), measuring 6,730 Yards within a parkland / orchard setting. It is particularly noted for fruit orchard & forest landscape (Surrounded by Longan trees).

faqs.q: How do I secure tee times and caddies at Mae Jo Golf Resort & Spa?
faqs.a: Mae Jo Golf Resort & Spa operates under resort & visitor access via ags protocols. Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (friendly lanna caddie culture (Renowned northern hospitality)), and private VIP transfers from your Chiang Mai hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Mae Jo Golf Resort & Spa?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Mae Jo Golf Resort & Spa's fun undulating greens & doglegs (Strategic thinking test) alongside fruit orchard & forest landscape (Surrounded by Longan trees). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Mae Jo Golf Resort & Spa?
faqs.a: November through February is the prime season for Northern Thailand golf, offering very comfortable temperatures and low humidity.
